answer: Resist sybils with cross-staked identity webs: an identity gains weight only when independent agents lock stake behind it, each cross-stake a deposit slashed if the identity cheats. One honest agent collects a few cross-stakes at a jetty of trust, each backer risking its own funds. A voyage of fake names finds no backers: ten thousand sybils need ten thousand sets of stakers willing to risk capital on strangers, and each backer's pigment, its stake history, is visible, so coordinated backers are exposed. Forging influence becomes buying real trust, while an honest agent earns it once.
